title: UI app metadata wrapping and tool result branding
answers: How should tool handlers attach UI app resources in services/mcp?
How does buildToolResultPayload prevent payload duplication for exec tools?
Can tool handlers manually construct the _meta response property?
body:
1. When rendering interactive UI apps, wrap tool definitions with `services/mcp/src/resources/ui-apps.ts:withUiApp`; never construct `_meta` manually.
2. `services/mcp/src/resources/ui-apps.ts:withUiApp` enforces that `appKey` matches a known entry in `services/mcp/src/resources/ui-apps.generated.ts:UiAppKey` and attaches `RESOURCE_URI_META_KEY`.
3. In `services/mcp/src/lib/build-tool-result.ts:buildToolResultPayload`, payloads constructed by `services/mcp/src/tools/exec.ts` must be branded with `EXEC_BUILT_PAYLOAD` via `markExecPayload` to prevent double-wrapping and accidental object-rest destructuring of `content` / `structuredContent`.
4. Primitive string responses passed to `buildToolResultPayload` are preserved as plain text rather than being destructured into character-indexed dictionary objects.
applies: Applies to all MCP tool handlers returning UI app cards or returning results via the exec tool wrapper.
